deadline.value: The school's Fall intake window runs September 1 to January 15 (year inferred); Graduate Studies lists Fall 2027 applications as open until February 15, 2027. Apply by January 15 to be safe.

also.quote: Accepting applications for Fall 2027 start: September 1, 2026 - February 15, 2027

gre_general.quote: We do not require GRE test.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must find a faculty member willing to supervise you before admission; contact professors directly.
supervisor.quote: PhD program is a research-based program and applicants are expected to identify a Supervisor prior to admission. Applicants are required to reach out to individual professors / faculty members to seek commitment as their thesis supervisor.

funding.value: Thesis-based PhD students get guaranteed funding, mostly as research funding from the supervisor for 4 years; TA posts and fellowships are extra and competitive. The package is stated in the offer letter.
funding.quote: The School of Engineering Science provides financial support to thesis based PhD and MASc students.

also.quote: The research funding for PhD lasts for 4 years.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, physics, computer science or a related field is required.
entry_route.quote: must have a master's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, physics, computer science or a related field

notes: Research areas include communications and signal processing, biomedical engineering, microelectronics, systems and robotics, and computer engineering.
name: PhD in Engineering Science
